## Goal
One page, "Help topics", that lists every help page in plain words, and one link to it from `docs/user/INSTALL.md`. This is what makes the WO-311..320 pages reachable.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- `docs/user/help-topics.md` groups the pages under plain headings ("Getting started", "Using Free My ID", "Staying safe", "For helpers"), one line each: link plus a short description. It lists the existing pages (INSTALL, troubleshooting, HELPING, GLOSSARY, the three mail pages) and the new ones: whats-new-0.3, what-to-do-when, is-this-you, practice-mode, google-and-bing, protect-yourself, larger-text, never-asks, printable-checklist, helping-by-phone.
- `docs/user/INSTALL.md` gets one short line near the end linking to `help-topics.md`, and nothing else changes in it.
- All copilot doc tests pass with no expected failures, including `test_cp_user_docs_reachable.py` for every new page.
- If a page from the list was rejected or isn't merged, leave it out and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** text only and offline. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Plain words per `docs/POSITIONING.md`: no "guarantee", "erase", "100%" or "nothing is sent"; say "requested" and "confirmed". A real product bug is a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md (or a strict `xfail` in a test); never edit `src/`. Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/` and `tests/grok/` first; don't duplicate a guard.
